request.description: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful. Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it. Class: a mountain for a square-grid strategy map, drawn as one raised terrain feature: one connected mass, calmer and less saturated than units, simple readable shapes, no face and no eyes. It stands on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under it, no ground slab, no soil square, no tile and no platform. Subject: one single small mountain, a little wider than tall, with two or three soft rounded humps joined into one mass, in a cosy storybook look: chubby, rounded, toy-like forms; warm brown-grey rock (light #a39480, shade #7a6c60) with a few chunky ledges; the outline is a dark brown tone of the rock (#4a3d36), never black; only a small rounded cream-white snow cap on the highest top; the lower third is green foothills: rounded grass-green (#7fae55) slopes with a few tiny round dark-green bushes and one or two tiny pine trees, so the mountain grows out of a meadow and has no grey base; it fills the image from the left edge to the right edge. Must not include: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject, ground plate, platform, grass square, soil patch, slab, isometric block, background, sky, clouds, buildings, characters, people, river, lake.
